_real_world.class: Island-integrated fixed-face AESA volume-search radar, designation not officially disclosed
public_equipment: island-integrated fixed-face AESA (public designation not confirmed)

_provenance.modeling_note: Named by role, not by designation, per authoring instruction: Fujian's main radar is officially undisclosed. 'Type 346B' is a Tier-C-only speculation (csg-cn-fujian-eurasiareview relays it as a guess, csg-cn-fujian-nsj says 'possibly'; csg-cn-fujian-csis-chinapower lists the radar as 'TBD'). This record therefore models a generic island-integrated fixed-face AESA volume-search radar consistent with the qualitative B-tier description in csg-cn-fujian-navaltech/csg-cn-fujian-twz-2024, and borrows the 500-600 km Type-346B-on-055 figure only as an upper-bound reasoning anchor, not as a confirmed Fujian fit.

sensor.type.note: island-integrated fixed-face AESA is a radar; Radar is the matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: no Fujian-specific figure exists (designation itself is unconfirmed); 300000.0 m set as a conservative fraction of the C-only 500-600 km Type-346B-on-055 estimate, reasoning that an undisclosed Fujian-specific array should not be assumed equal to 055's larger dedicated air-defence radar

sensor.fov_deg.note: 360 deg: a multi-face fixed island-integrated array gives full coverage, consistent with the engine's single-merged-radar convention used for 346-series arrays elsewhere in this packet

sensor.scan_period.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo's other large naval AESA volume-search modules (SPY-1D(V) MVP pattern)

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; engineering estimate consistent with a modern AESA search radar, slightly below the SPY-1D(V) proxy given the undisclosed/less-mature Fujian fit

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default for a search radar, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, consistent with the packet's simplified surface-search detection model convention

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant, paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce max_range at a reference target; no public figure

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention used across this packet's other naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public island/mast height for Fujian; engineering estimate slightly above the SPY-1D(V) proxy mount height, consistent with a large carrier island superstructure

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern (horizon-geometry bias term)

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne air/surface search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with the packet's simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled consistent with the packet's convention for a long-range search radar

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: carried close to the repo's SPY-1D(V) proxy pattern

modeling_notes: Designation deliberately omitted from 'name' and 'class' per task instruction: no public source confirms 'Type 346B' or any other designation for Fujian's main radar. csg-cn-fujian-csis-chinapower explicitly lists it as 'TBD'.
